title: A leap year checker
description:
Say whether a year is a leap year and how many days February has.

```
Year: 1900
1900 is not a leap year; February has 28 days.
Year: 2024
2024 is a leap year; February has 29 days.
```
hints: A ternary chooses the words: `leap ? "is" : "is not"` and `leap ? 29 : 28`.
requirements: A leap year divides by 4, except years that divide by 100, unless they also divide by 400.
Write it as one `boolean` expression with `&&`, `||` and `!`.
Keep asking until the user types `0`.
stretch: Count the leap years between two years the user enters.
